name: TAVERN
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Folk session in a tavern corner. Regulars come, play, fall out, go home.
description: TAVERN turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a small folk session that plays all night by itself. Eight regulars with fiddles, a whistle, a harp, a lute, a box, a bass and a bodhran drift in and out of a tavern corner: one starts a tune, the others join on the repeat, rivals refuse to play together, strangers are welcomed or frozen out, someone plays a lament. Tunes are generated in folk modes, reels and jigs in the busy middle of the night, slow airs late. The regulars, their quarrels and memorable nights are kept across power-offs.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
